title: Grok Chatbot Reportedly Posted a False Claim on X That German Advocacy Group Campact Received Substantial Federal Funding
summary: The Grok chatbot reportedly posted a public X reply claiming that Campact, a German advocacy group, received a large share of its funding from federal sources. The Hamburg Regional Court treated the claim as false and damaging to Campact's reputation in a preliminary injunction barring xAI, the account's operator, from repeating it.
